svg.text: SECTION THROUGH ONE ARM · 1:5 · SCHEME C
BIG DRAWER OUT · INNER ONE PULLED OUT BEHIND ITS FRONT · 1:10
BOTH DRAWERS SHUT · 1:10 · THE PIPE DROPS THROUGH BOTH NOTCHES
THE INNER DRAWER HIDES BEHIND THE BIG FRONT · 1:10
THE SAME DRAWER IN ALL THREE SCHEMES
Inner box 437 deep, 75 high, 12 ply; notch 250 wide.
open. Its sides stop at 430 to pass under the inner.
18 BWP, teak veneer both faces, top edge
scooped for a finger. No handle.
Open the big drawer: the inner one stays put. Pull it
and it comes out 410 behind the big front, over the
bottles — the tray in the kitchen drawer photographed.
Both are U-boxes. The waste pipe drops through their
notches whichever drawer is shut; neither may be solid
It can never pass the big front — that front is solid.
Below the inner drawer: 255 clear — tall bottles stand.
Normal version: the pipe is off centre, which leaves
the inner drawer a 25 right arm. Too thin to keep — that
arm is left off and the inner drawer is an L.

g.text: The big drawer, and a drawer inside it
